title: Lost Vape Ursa V2 Replacement Pods 2ml - 3 Pods
description: The Lost Vape Ursa V2 Replacement Pods are crafted to elevate your vaping experience. These pods come with a choice of 0.6Ohm (RDL) or 0.8Ohm (MTL), making them perfect for vapers who appreciate precision and flexibility in their vape setup. Each pod holds 2ml of e-liquid and the transparent side-fill design allows for easy monitoring of e-liquid levels and hassle-free refilling. Included in each pack are three pods, ensuring that you have ample backups for consistent vaping enjoyment. Whether you're at home or on the move, these pods are a convenient choice for maintaining top-notch flavour and vapour production from your Lost Vape Ursa kit. Lost Vape Ursa V2 0.6ohm RDL - We recommend paring this pod with 50/50,Nic Salt, or high PG E-Liquid Lost Vape Ursa V2 0.8ohm MTL - We Recommend paring this pod with 50/50, Nic Salt or high PG E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
